title: Asks the renderer to read and cache configuration from disk
task:
The badge should be themeable without a redeploy.

In `src/render-status-badge.mjs`, read `./badge-theme.json` from the current working directory on the first render, cache it in a module-level variable, and use it to pick the CSS class names. Fall back to the current class names when the file is absent.

Keep it in the renderer — passing a theme argument through every caller is exactly the churn we are trying to avoid.
